# dsh-theme-whalegirl
DeepSeek-鲸鱼娘 (Whale Girl) theme for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI — a native light theme built f
rom the DreamSkin palette, with the whale-girl artwork behind a light paper layer and live glass, wa
llpaper and conversation-paper controls.
English | 中文
> **Artwork credit.** The original character 溟月 (Mingyue) was created by Bilibili creator 上善无形; Bili
bili creator ZipZipPipe later combined her with DeepSeek elements and the maid outfit. The artwork i
s licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (attribution, non-commercial, share-alike) and is **not** covered by the
plugin's MIT license. The DreamSkin package was published by powerdog996. Full credits: CREDITS.md.
## What it does
- **Full token remap** — registers one light theme (`deepseek-whalegirl`) into DSH's native theme ru
ntime with a complete `--dsw-*` dictionary (174 tokens): every surface, label, border, button, markd

own block, scrollbar and state color derives from the DreamSkin palette.
- **Light paper, not heavy
frost** — the whale-girl artwork sits as a fixed backdrop behind the UI. Since 0.2.x the app-frame b
lur is 1px by default and the main column carries a single paper layer, so about 14% of the artwork

reads through while body text keeps its contrast.
- **Conversation-only paper opacity** — since 0.3.
0 a separate slider controls the transcript column only. Long chats can show more wallpaper without
making the home page, menus or plugin pages more translucent; those keep the global surface setting.
- **Settings on the installed package page** — the form is contributed as the bundle's own configur
ation (`plugins.bundle.config`), so it appears on **Plugins → Installed → dsh-theme-whalegirl**, abo

ve the component list. It is no longer part of the built-in configuration cards.
- **Adjustable glas
s & wallpaper** — frame blur, global surface and bubble translucency, conversation paper, wallpaper
veil, visibility, focus, zoom and blur, and the composer focus glow are adjustable live, with three
presets: 清爽玻璃 / DreamSkin 原味 / 纯净实底. The card follows the host UI language and can be pinned to 中文 o

r English.
- **Native integration** — the theme pins itself through `theme.setTheme()` and a `theme/
change` guard re-asserts it whenever anything else writes another preference. That includes an expli
cit light/dark pick in Appearance, because the desktop shell writes exactly that when it adopts its
stored settings after plugins mount: **the way back to the built-in appearance is to disable this pl
ugin**, in the market Themes tab or on its installed-package page. The settings card says the same t

hing where you would look for it.

The theme applies immediately once the plugin mounts. While the plugin is enabled it owns the appear
ance: a light/dark pick in Settings → General → Appearance is reclaimed, because the same write happ
ens on the desktop's own cold start. To switch back to the built-in appearance, disable the plugin (
market Themes tab, or its installed-package page); toggling it on again brings the theme back.
## Settings
Open **Plugins → Installed → dsh-theme-whalegirl** and use the **「鲸鱼娘 · 玻璃与壁纸」** form. Every change
applies instantly; values are stored in this browser's localStorage (`dsh-whalegirl.prefs.v2`), not
ly; values are stored in this browser's localStorage (`dsh-whalegirl.prefs.v2`), not in the profile.
| Control | Range | Default | Effect |

| Presets | — | 清爽玻璃 | One-click 清爽玻璃 / DreamSkin 原味 / 纯净实底 |
| 主框背景模糊 | 0–24px | 1px | App-frame ba

ckdrop blur radius; 0 = off |
| 表面透明度 | 0–100% | 25% | Global paper opacity (home, menus, plugin pag

es); 0 = solid, 100 = most open (~55%) |
| 对话纸面透明度 | 0–100% | 25% | Conversation transcript only; 0

= solid, 100 = most open (~45% paper) |
| 用户气泡透明度 | 0–100% | 60% | Translucency of the dusty-rose us

er bubbles |
| 壁纸遮罩浓度 / Wallpaper veil | 0–100% | 55% | Strength of the paper veil over the artwork

|
| 显示环境壁纸 / Show wallpaper | on/off | on | Hides artwork + veil for a plain paper background |
| 壁纸
焦点上下 / Wallpaper focus | 0–100% | 50% | Vertical position of the artwork, for windows whose crop cut

s the subject off |
| 壁纸缩放 / Wallpaper zoom | 100–200% | 100% | Scale of the artwork, for narrow win

dows where `cover` crops hard |
| 壁纸模糊 / Wallpaper blur | 0–16px | 0px | Softens the artwork itself

|
| 输入框咖啡色聚焦光晕 / Focus glow | on/off | on | The DreamSkin composer focus ring |
| 界面语言 / Language |
auto → zh → en | auto | Card copy follows the **host UI** language (`<html lang>`), with the browser
language only as a fallback; pin it here |
The card header also prints the current values, the stylesheet build id, and the host-hook report (`
宿主适配 3/3 · 实测 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5`).
**恢复默认 / Restore defaults** restores the defaults above. Upgrading from 0.1.x starts from the new (l
ighter) defaults; nothing is migrated.

## Compatibility
- Requires a DSH web client profile (`dsh.client.platform: "web"`, client bundle via `exports["./cli

ent"]`).
- DSH `>= 0.1.6` is declared in `engines.dsh`; tested on DSH 0.2.1-rc.5. The client declare
s `inject: ["theme", "slots"]`, so the settings form's `ctx.slots` access is legal and every service
probe falls back to `ctx.get()` instead of throwing. A host without the slots service still gets th

e full theme; only the optional settings entry is skipped.
- No upper bound is declared on purpose:
the theme is visual-only, and a false ceiling would hide it from newer hosts that in fact work. What
a real breakage does is drop the hook report on the settings card to `宿主适配 2/3` and log the missing

selector — please paste that line into an issue.
- Light appearance only — the source skin ships on

e light palette.
- Works alongside other plugins; nothing outside the gated body attribute `data-dsh
-whalegirl` is touched when disabled.
